name: Apache HugeGraph Open-Source Graph Database
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted graph database with Gremlin and Cypher querying, REST API and graph processing tools; no license fee or vendor-hosted free resource quota.
watch_out: Compute, backend storage, network, security, backups, operations and optional external Spark/Flink/LLM services are paid or user-operated separately. This is not a free managed graph-database plan.
